description: YHEpoxy-GR90 is a three-component, solvent-free, high-performance epoxy resin grout based on modified epoxy resin, selected inorganic fillers and a modified hardener.
whereToUse: Grouting under reciprocating or rotating equipment, such as pumps, compressors and machinery
Grouting and repair of heavy-duty crane rails, conveyor tracks and industrial equipment foundations
Grouting of base plates, anchor bolts and machine foundations subject to vibration or impact
Re-profiling, repair and waterproofing of pile caps
Providing a level and durable bearing surface prior to bridge bearing installation
advantages: High compressive strength and impact resistance
notFor: Do not split packs or alter the prescribed mixing ratio.
Place the mixed grout from one side only to avoid air entrapment.
Protect all materials from extreme temperature.
